title: High throughput sequencing of polyA-RNAs in HIV treated patients and healthy controls
description: PolyA-RNA sequencing on Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells in patients infected with HIV and healthy donnors. Patients were effectively treated with cART (virological controlled and CD4+ T-cell counts over 500) for an extended period.  HIV infected patients were not coinfected with HCV or HBV.

samples.title: 026C
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral venous blood samples were collected in EDTA tubes. Total RNA was extracted from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells with the RNeasy minikit (Qiagen™), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were synthesize with the Illumina’s TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit v2 using 500 nanogram of total RNA following manufacturer’s protocol.

runs.experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: High throughput sequencing of polyA-RNAs in HIV treated patients and healthy controls
